Package aor.proj3t.resource

Class ExportResource

java.lang.Object
aor.proj3t.resource.ExportResource
@Path("/export") @RequestScoped public class ExportResource extends Object
REST resource handler for exporting data in various formats.

This resource provides endpoints for exporting system data into formats such as CSV. Currently supports user data exports with optional filtering capabilities.

  • Method Details

    • exportUsersToCSV

      @GET @Path("/users/csv") @Produces("text/csv") public jakarta.ws.rs.core.Response exportUsersToCSV(@HeaderParam("Authorization") String authHeader)
      Exports all users in the system to a CSV file.

      This endpoint generates a CSV file containing all users in the system. The CSV includes user details such as ID, email, name, role, etc. The endpoint requires authentication.

      Parameters:
      authHeader - the authorization header containing the JWT token
      Returns:
      a Response with the CSV data and appropriate headers for file download

    • exportFilteredUsersToCSV

      @GET @Path("/users/csv/filtered") @Produces("text/csv") public jakarta.ws.rs.core.Response exportFilteredUsersToCSV(@HeaderParam("Authorization") String authHeader, @BeanParam UserFilter filters)
      Exports filtered users to a CSV file.

      This endpoint generates a CSV file containing users that match the specified filters. Filters can be applied to various user properties such as role, workplace, etc. The endpoint requires authentication.

      Parameters:
      authHeader - the authorization header containing the JWT token
      filters - a bean containing filter criteria to apply to the user list
      Returns:
      a Response with the CSV data and appropriate headers for file download

    • exportEvaluationToPDF

      @GET @Path("/evaluations/{id}/pdf") @Produces("application/pdf") public jakarta.ws.rs.core.Response exportEvaluationToPDF(@HeaderParam("Authorization") String authHeader, @PathParam("id") Long evaluationId)
      Exports a single evaluation to a PDF file with detailed information.

      This endpoint generates a PDF document containing comprehensive details about a specific evaluation, including information about the evaluator, evaluated user, and the evaluation itself. The endpoint requires authentication.

      Parameters:
      authHeader - the authorization header containing the JWT token
      evaluationId - the ID of the evaluation to export
      Returns:
      a Response with the PDF data and appropriate headers for file download
